press_references.value: n8n adds Chat Hub to centralize AI access inside automation workflows

product_launches.description: n8n launched Chat Hub, a new built-in feature that centralizes conversational AI and workflow-backed agents in a single chat interface within its automation platform.

press_references.value: AI-Powered Feature Engineering with n8n: Scaling Data Science Intelligence

product_launches.description: n8n has launched an AI-powered feature engineering workflow that integrates LLMs, statistical analysis, and professional reporting to automate and scale data science feature engineering across organizations.

press_references.value: New n8n MCP Lets AI Create your Entire Automation : Say Goodbye to Workflow Errors

product_launches.description: n8n has launched the Model Context Protocol (MCP), a new AI-powered tool that automates workflow creation, validation, and deployment, making automation more accessible and reducing errors.

press_references.value: New n8n Cloud Community Nodes : Makes Automations Easier Than Ever

product_launches.description: n8n has launched community nodes on its cloud platform, allowing users to access and install user-created modules for workflow automation without the need for self-hosting. This update makes advanced automation tools more accessible and user-friendly, with 25 verified nodes available at launch and plans for ongoing expansion.

press_references.value: New n8n Folders Feature for Better Workflow Management

product_launches.description: The folders feature allows users to organize workflows into categorized and nested folders, improving clarity and navigation for complex automation systems.

press_references.value: Scrape Google for LinkedIn Profiles in Seconds

product_launches.description: n8n introduces a workflow for automating LinkedIn profile extraction from Google search results, enhancing lead generation efficiency.

press_references.value: n8n 2.0 Release : Brings Cleaner Design, Publish Rules, Data Returns, and Quicker Saves

product_launches.description: n8n released version 2.0 of its workflow automation platform, featuring a redesigned interface, improved subworkflow publishing, performance upgrades, and new productivity tools.

overview_description.description: N8n provides a flexible AI workflow automation platform that supports building and integrating multi-step AI agents and applications. The tool is designed for technical teams, offering options for drag-and-drop building or code-based customization. N8n offers self-hosting capability, allowing users to deploy on-premise, or use a hosted cloud-based version with over 500 integrations.

about_short_description.short_description: N8n is a workflow automation tool that integrates AI capabilities with business process automation.

product.name: n8n Workflow Automation Platform
product.description: A visual workflow automation platform for connecting applications, transforming data, and automating business processes with low-code tools and custom JavaScript or Python.

product.name: n8n Cloud
product.description: A hosted version of the n8n workflow automation platform that lets teams build and run integrations and AI-enabled workflows without managing the underlying infrastructure.

product.name: Self-hosted n8n
product.description: A customer-managed deployment option for running n8n on private infrastructure, including on-premises environments and Docker-based installations.

product.name: n8n Enterprise
product.description: An enterprise offering that adds security, governance, collaboration, observability, and deployment controls for organizations running workflow and AI automation at scale.

product.name: Embedded n8n (OEM)
product.description: A capability for embedding n8n workflow automation into another software product or service, enabling product teams to provide workflow functionality to their own users.
